summary: Comprehensive backend + UI smoke testing of VortexGuard v1.0 exam engine and student single-device binding. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass covering: device-binding (login requires device_id, same device OK, different device 403, reset-device bumps token_version so old session 401 and new device logs in), exam CRUD + validation (empty question text, PG <2 options, per_page out of range, end<start), full student flow with allow_back=true (start, progress, go-back allowed, essay submit -> pending), grading (PG with points -> 400, over max -> 400, essay with valid points -> graded + total = pg+essay), DELETE attempt resets so student can retake, allow_back=false blocks going back (400) and locks earlier answers at submit, show_score=false hides score/percent/total from student in both /attempt and /results, siswa receives 403 on POST /exams and PATCH grade. UI smoke verified super-admin can open class Ujian tab, VortexGuard v1.0 dashboard header + 4 stats cards render with correct data-testids, 'Tentang Sistem' info modal shows VortexGuard content, 'Buat Ujian' builder opens with the 4 expected tabs (Informasi / Soal / Tampilan & Navigasi / Keamanan & Aturan) and ringkasan panel, Hasil modal opens with VortexGuard header, filter chips (Semua, Menunggu koreksi, Selesai dinilai, Lulus KKM, Belum lulus), CSV export button, sortable table columns, and search field. Full student exam-take UI (fullscreen gate) was not driven headlessly on purpose – backend already covers the server-side logic; main agent / manual QA should spot-check in a real browser.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal does not close on Escape key or backdrop click; only the X button closes it. Minor UX improvement.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Add Escape key + backdrop click handlers to VortexInfoModal and other full-screen modals (ExamBuilder/ExamResults) to improve UX.
No functional issues found; feature is production-ready based on tested scope.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5939 lines – very long. Consider splitting (exam engine ~2249-2727 could be its own module).
VortexGuard exam engine is well-structured: server-side allow_back enforcement, locked-page merging, and token_version bump on reset-device are all correctly implemented.
exam_out() uses `password_hash` pop which mutates the DB document returned by motor; current pattern works because docs are re-fetched per request, but passing a copy would be safer.
No input length guard on exam `title` and `description`; consider max_length to prevent abuse.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all tested surfaces work; info modal Esc-to-close missing)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates TEST_VG<hex> class + TEST_ students + exams and cleans them up in fixture teardown. UI test seeds + deletes a TEST_VGUI_* class/exam each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend file test_iter48_vortexguard_exams.py is reusable regression suite. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_iter48_vortexguard_exams.py -n 0. Device-binding tests reset bindings during the module, so running concurrently with other suites using the same test student would race. UI full-exam-take flow (ExamTake + anti-cheat fullscreen) was intentionally NOT exercised headlessly because the exam locks until fullscreen is granted and headless Chromium cannot grant it; use a real browser if you need to click through the running-exam view.
